chapters.title: Fund once. Reuse.
sentences: A thousand paid API calls shouldn't mean a thousand payment transactions.
AgentPay funds one stream and reuses it across requests.

chapters.title: Intelligence needs guardrails
sentences: But agents can hallucinate: keep paying a broken service, or close a useful stream too early.
Their money needs deterministic guardrails.

chapters.title: Chainlink CRE
sentences: Chainlink C R E turns live data into deterministic payment decisions.

chapters.title:
Check before
you commit.
chapters.label: PRICE + ADMISSION
chapters.detail:
USDC price · freshness
Service health · budget · rate
sentences: Here, C R E runs locally.
It compares Chainlink and Coinbase U S D C prices, checks freshness and price bounds, then checks service health, the deposit, and the stream rate.
Decision: OPEN.

chapters.title:
Dry-run.
Risk-score.
Record.
chapters.label: SPEND REVIEW
chapters.detail:
Durable decision blobs
Hashes anchored onchain
sentences: Before signing, the proposed spend is dry-run and risk-scored.
Decisions are stored as durable blobs, with hashes anchored onchain.

chapters.title:
Approved.
Verified.
Funded.
chapters.label: CONTRACT ENFORCEMENT
chapters.detail:
Separate policy signer
Escrow verifies OPEN approval
sentences: A separate policy signer approves OPEN.
The escrow verifies that signature, then accepts one cent of U S D C.

chapters.title:
One stream.
Ten calls.
chapters.label: REUSE
chapters.detail:
No payment transaction
for each API request
sentences: Ten API calls reuse the same stream, with no payment transaction per request.
C R E returns CONTINUE; the provider earns by the second.

chapters.title:
Service fails.
Rules respond.
chapters.label: FAILURE CHECKPOINT
chapters.detail:
Three injected HTTP 503s
Deterministic failure threshold
sentences: Now, three service failures.
C R E applies the failure threshold and returns CLOSE, protecting the remaining deposit.

chapters.title:
Close.
Settle.
Refund.
chapters.label: VERIFIED CANCELLATION
chapters.detail:
Provider: accrued earnings
Payer: unused deposit
sentences: The contract verifies the CLOSE approval.
Cancellation pays the provider's accrued earnings and refunds the unused balance.

chapters.title:
Over budget?
Blocked.
chapters.label: BUDGET GUARDRAIL
chapters.detail:
No purchase signed
Blocked decision recorded
sentences: A premium request exceeds the spending cap.
C R E returns DENY.
No purchase is signed, and the blocked decision gets its own audit receipt.

Reuse safely.

chapters.detail:
Deterministic payment guardrails
Decisions you can trace
sentences: AgentPay. Fund once. Reuse safely.
Deterministic Chainlink C R E guardrails, with decisions you can trace.
